_comment: DEMO ONLY -- lets the app run before anything is deployed. `demo: true` is what the app reads: the bridge contracts below are PLACEHOLDERS that point at nothing, so every mirror check renders as unknown rather than as a refusal, and connecting a wallet will not bridge. veil.pool and veil.factory are real Starknet Sepolia contracts, so the pool checks run for real. veil.proverEndpoint and veil.masterAddress are blank: without them the app says note creation is unavailable instead of failing inside the prover.
